lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a structured grid pattern with roughly equidistant spacing between nodes in the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix where the blobs act as primary intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, randomly distributed high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more densely packed than the primary flank constellations.
